summary: Fixes a startup crash on the owner's real database. The channels branch's migration 005 was already recorded there, so this branch's own migration 005 was skipped and the next migration failed on a missing column (shown as 'project load failed'). Migrations are now tracked per number instead of by highest version, this branch's migrations are renumbered 006/007 with slot 5 reserved for channels, and each migration runs in a transaction that rolls back completely on failure.
scope_note: On top of bbcdf2a. Migrations are a critical path. Verified only on a read-only copy of the real database; the real database was not touched.

budget_impact.rationale: No model call, no outbound request, no budget change.
budget_impact.before: Opening the app on a database that had run another branch's migration 005 crashed at startup.
budget_impact.after: Both branches' migrations run regardless of numbering order; failures roll back.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: PaperDigHelper.app rebuilt; its bundled backend migrated a copy of the real database 5 -> 7 and served both projects; the window was not opened by the agent

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; migration runner and numbering only

open_risks: Not independently reviewed; the fix was verified by reproducing the failure and by migrating a copy of the real database.

Merging with the channels branch needs a human step: replace migrate_005_reserved_for_channels with migrate_005_channels; both branches also define ADR 0010/0011 numbers and settings routes that were not compared.
A database that ran this branch's old migration 005 (development copies only) has version 5 recorded without channels tables; a channels build opening it would skip its own 005.
The real database will be migrated 5 -> 7 on first start of the rebuilt app; the existing .pre-v5.bak backup is reused, not refreshed.
